name: Demo: search is slow but nothing is failing
description: The counterpart to the outage scenario, and the case that shows why the classify step calls a model at all. The node's keyword rule reads this report as 'high' — it matches the word 'errors' in the sentence 'nothing errors', which says the opposite. A model reading the sentence should answer 'medium'. Run it keyless and you get the rule's answer back, labelled severity_source=stub-fixture, because the agent hands the gateway its own fixture and the gateway says it was the stub that replied; configure a provider key and you get the model's answer, labelled severity_source=model. Either way the severity is not 'critical', which is what the stub would synthesise on its own: a fixture is never passed off as a judgement, and the label is read from the reply rather than assumed.
